mapper.select:
SELECT , t_notice_type.notice_type_name as noticeTypeName FROM t_notice LEFT JOIN t_notice_type on t_notice.notice_type_id = t_notice_type.notice_type_id
AND t_notice_type.notice_type_id = #{query.noticeTypeId}
AND ( INSTR(t_notice.title,#{query.keywords}) OR INSTR(t_notice.author,#{query.keywords}) OR INSTR(t_notice.source,#{query.keywords}) )
AND INSTR(t_notice.document_number, #{query.documentNumber})
AND t_notice.create_user_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM QuickBlue_system.t_employee WHERE actual_name = #{query.createUserName} )
AND t_notice.deleted_flag = #{query.deletedFlag}
AND DATE_FORMAT(t_notice.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.createTimeBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(t_notice.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.createTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(t_notice.publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.publishTimeBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(t_notice.publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.publishTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY t_notice.publish_time DESC, t_notice.notice_id DESC
